Rank 32 · fires on 0.0864% of 10M tokens · 8,638 active observations · complete

Gate-activation hypothesis

The gate activates on prepositions (in, of, about) and nouns (hope, expectations) that follow adjectives or verbs expressing confidence, trust, or anticipation. It fires strongly when the preceding context indicates self-assurance or belief in a specific outcome, and weakly when the context involves doubt, skepticism, or general expectations.

Describes when the gate fires. It does not establish the transform’s causal output effect.
